actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes two [[/item .mmSlam0000000000]] attacks and uses [[/item .mmUnsettlingVisa]] if available.

actions.name: slam
actions.desc: [[/attack]] ([[lookup @activation.condition activity=mEQjWdqU7zGv6Ott]]), reach [[lookup @range.value activity=mEQjWdqU7zGv6Ott]] [[lookup @range.units activity=mEQjWdqU7zGv6Ott]]. [[/damage average extended]].

actions.name: read thoughts
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectThou]{Detect Thoughts}, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @abilities.cha.dc]]).

actions.name: unsettling visage
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=USxIbGZPLvfPnnoI]], each [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=USxIbGZPLvfPnnoI]] in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=USxIbGZPLvfPnnoI]]-foot Emanation originating from the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} that can see the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. Failure: The target has the &Reference[Frightened apply=false] condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After [[lookup @duration.value activity=USxIbGZPLvfPnnoI]] [[lookup @duration.units activity=USxIbGZPLvfPnnoI]], it succeeds automatically.

actions.name: shape-shift
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} shape-shifts into a [[lookup @target.affects.special activity=EU2q25V5hIaM1ZlR]], or it returns to its true form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.
